mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and increases risk appetite, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is negative or not significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals a tight labor market that increases inflationary pressures and prompts monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market tightness, increasing inflation expectations and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market tightness
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS change * UNRATE change) does not have a significant negative coefficient (p>0.05) in a regression of 60-day returns on the interaction term and individual series over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1pp in 1 month) signals an active monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and increasing risk appetite, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day forward returns is negative or not significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 600 thousand units (HOUST > 600) signals robust residential construction and strong economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 600.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong demand and supply-side expansion, boosting corporate earnings and risk appetite, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST change * INDPRO change) does not have a significant positive coefficient (p>0.05) in a regression of 20-day returns on the interaction term and individual series over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing and supply-side activity, supporting corporate earnings and increasing risk appetite, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day forward returns is negative or not significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
